grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: A Morning Routine Chat
instructions: 听录音，完成8个问题。录音会播放两遍。注意听时间、频率和日常活动。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: A: Hi, I'm Li Ming. I'm a student. I get up at six thirty every day. B: Oh, I get up at seven. I'm a teacher. A: Do you have breakfast at home? B: Yes, I do. I have eggs and milk. A: I have breakfast at school. I have bread and water. B: What time do you go to school? A: I go to school at seven forty. B: I go to work at eight. A: Do you walk to work? B: No, I don't. I take the bus. A: I walk to school. It's near. B: Do you do sports? A: Yes, I play basketball after school. B: I don't play sports. I read books at home. A: I read books, too. I read at nine. B: I read at ten. A: Good night! B: Good night!

questions.explanation: 录音中李明说“I get up at six thirty every day.”，所以是六点半。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: B说“I have eggs and milk.”，所以是鸡蛋和牛奶。

questions.prompt: 李明早餐吃什么？请填一个食物单词。
questions.explanation: 李明说“I have bread and water.”，所以食物是bread。
B说“I take the bus.”，所以是坐公交车。

questions.prompt: 李明放学后做什么运动？
questions.explanation: 李明说“I play basketball after school.”，所以是打篮球。

questions.prompt: B（老师）在家做什么？请填一个动词。
questions.explanation: B说“I read books at home.”，所以动词是read。
李明说“I read at nine.”，所以是九点。
B说“I read at ten.”，所以是十点。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，例如：I get up at six. You walk to school. We play basketball. They read books. 否定形式在动词前加 don't，例如：I don't play sports. 疑问形式在句首加 Do，例如：Do you have breakfast?
grammar.example: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，所以“I get up at seven.”正确。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty every day.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，否定用 don't + 动词原形，所以“I don't play sports.”正确。
主语是 you，疑问句在句首加 Do，所以“Do you walk to school?”正确。
questions.evidence: Do you have breakfast at home?

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 play，所以“We play basketball.”正确。

part1: What time do you get up?
Do you have breakfast at home?
How do you go to school or work?
What do you do after school or work?
speaking.part2: Describe your daily routine. You should say:
part3: Do you do sports every day?
What time do you read books?
Do you walk to school or take the bus?
What do you have for breakfast?

transfer.writing: 写一段话介绍你的日常安排。用一般现在时，至少5句话。包括：起床时间、早餐、上学/上班方式、课后活动、读书时间。
